notes: First public release, for any embedded Linux device with a serial console - on Windows and Linux
One tab per device and an All devices tab; auto login as root (user changeable) with your saved passwords
Memory and CPU of every process, live charts, crashes, reboots and memory leaks caught, a report for every session
Highlights, quick filter, search, blacklist and whitelist with plain text or patterns - and a pattern suggested from example lines
The log in any browser or over TCP, test cases, command shortcuts and shortcut buttons, Change IP, pinned lines
Command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P): find and run any command
Help > Try with a simulated device: see every feature without a real device
Help > Tutorial shows every feature; Help > Check for updates installs new versions; errors can be reported with one click
